'''Luire''' was the primary [[Star/Legends|star]] of the [[Luire system]], in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It was orbited by seven [[Planet/Legends|planets]]: [[Nyriaan/Legends|Nyriaan]], [[Caillte]] and five gas giants.
